cue: A phase-existence conclusion is drawn solely from bounded-window correlation fits, without uniform thermodynamic correlation bounds
fire_when: A positive-shear auxiliary model with tiny mu matches a massless sixfold correlation on all measured separations and is called a proven Riesz-gas hexatic phase
silent_when: The result is explicitly an auxiliary bounded-window estimate, or a microscopic theorem supplies uniform thermodynamic correlation bounds and defect control
text: Finite-window agreement can hide a positive plateau. State the thermodynamic limits and bound approximation error relative to decaying correlations; include defects before identifying a Riesz phase.
